sources.title: Qwen2-7B-Instruct · Models
sources.snippet: Qwen2-7B-Instruct Introduction Qwen2 is the new series of Qwen large language models. For Qwen2, we release a number of base language models and instruction-tuned language models ranging from 0.5 to 72 billion parameters, including a Mixture-of-Experts model. sources.title: Qwen2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract This report introduces the Qwen2 series, the latest addition to our large language models and large multimodal models. We release a comprehensive suite of foundational and instruction-tuned language models, encompassing a parameter range from 0.5 to 72 billion, featuring dense models and a Mixture-of-Experts model.
